baseline_models.focus_anchor: The threefold وَعَدَ/وَعْدَ/وَعَدتُّكُمْ is resolved by وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ versus فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Both speakers use the same hope-opening instrument, but truth and breach separate the promises at settlement: one is reality-matched and the other is exposed as an unperformed commitment.

activation_trace.role: A spoken promise opens expectation; its three occurrences place the two speakers inside one comparable promise form.
Reality-matched stability supplies the criterion that distinguishes the divine promise.
A promise that does not occur at its appointed time names the failure admitted by the second promiser.
Completion and expiry make the speech a post-performance audit rather than another live solicitation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts a true promise with a lie.
changed_reading.after: The ayah audits two formally comparable promises after performance is no longer postponable: truth is shown as durable correspondence, while deception is shown as an unbacked commitment that survives only until settlement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَاسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِي followed by وَلُومُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah negates coercive dominion, retains a verbal inclination, and assigns the completing act to the hearers' response. Blame therefore returns to the responding selves without erasing the caller's deception.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering force is explicitly negated as the caller's mechanism.
Calling inclines by voice and speech, supplying solicitation rather than compulsion.
Answering speech supplies the audience-side act that closes the influence circuit.
The doubled blame construction redirects moral accounting from caller alone to the responsive party.
The self as the thing's own identity localizes responsibility in the respondents themselves.

changed_reading.before: Satan caused the followers' error and then blamed them.
changed_reading.after: Satan supplied a deceptive verbal vector, but the followers supplied its uptake; the ayah distinguishes influence from force and makes response the point where external solicitation becomes one's own act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reciprocal مَا أَنَا بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِيَّ culminates in كَفَرْتُ بِمَا أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A relation installed as partnership is tested for reciprocal aid and fails in both directions. The attributed partner then disowns the partnership itself, leaving each party isolated at the moment relief is demanded.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation supplies the social relation whose promised reciprocity is being tested.
The repeated form evokes reciprocal cries for relief from both sides.
Aid in answer to a cry is denied symmetrically, demonstrating that the relation has no rescue capacity.
Disavowal and withdrawal terminate the alleged partnership when its benefits are claimed.
Distance and severance give the speaker's final withdrawal a spatial and relational edge.

changed_reading.before: Satan refuses to rescue his followers and denies their worship.
changed_reading.after: The speech is the liquidation of a false mutual-aid partnership: reciprocal rescue proves impossible, and the supposed partner severs the very share that had been assigned to him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier messenger dispute separates intelligible communication, clarified evidence, doubtful reception, and compelling authority. Against that field, Satan's admission classifies his power precisely: his call operated through language and uncertain uptake, not through coercive force or a defeating proof.

activation_trace.role: The focus negates overpowering force and anchors the model in the stated limit on Satan's agency.
The focus retains only verbal calling as the initiator of the causal sequence.
The respondents' answer is the audience-side completion of that sequence.
Language as a communicative medium shows that calls reach people through an intelligible social channel.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign distinguishes explanation from mere vocal pressure.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty identify the audience condition in which competing calls operate.
Agitated doubt sharpens the unstable reception field rather than supplying coercion.
A contrasting call toward forgiveness shows that calling itself does not predetermine the hearer's response.
The demand for a compelling proof distinguishes evidentiary authority from an invitation.
Capacity and delegated authority are said to depend on divine permission, making Satan's total denial of such authority sharper.

structural_cues: 14:4 first locates disclosure in the hearers' language; 14:9-11 then stages rejection, doubt, a call, and a demand for sultan before 14:22 names call without sultan.
The focus construction contrasts the negated category of authority with the sole retained category of calling, then assigns the next verb to the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies language, clarification, doubt, competing calls, and distinct branches of sultan; I infer that audience response converts communication into effective influence. A live alternative is that social pressure accompanies the call, but the focus still denies Satan a directly coercive or jurisdictional power.

changed_reading.before: The 'no authority, only a call' clause is mainly Satan's excuse.
changed_reading.after: The clause is also a compact theory of mediated influence: intelligible speech can solicit amid uncertainty, but it gains causal traction only through reception and cannot be redescribed as coercive dominion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding follower-leader exchange and the later closure of sale and intimate friendship frame Satan's reciprocal no-rescue as the collapse of an entire substitute support network. Hierarchical guidance, material exchange, and personal patronage all fail as routes of transfer.

activation_trace.role: The focus denies aid in response to distress in both directions, anchoring the failed-support reading.
The followers ask whether their leaders can suffice or avail them, exposing an expected support transfer.
Guidance as gentle direction appears as a relay the leaders admit they could not provide independently.
Exchange for a price supplies the transactional support route that the coming day explicitly closes.
Intimate affection penetrating the self supplies the personal support route that is likewise unavailable.

structural_cues: 14:21 places weak followers asking arrogant leaders for relief immediately before Satan speaks in 14:22.
The branchless follower construction in 14:21 supplies the social hierarchy, while 14:31's coordinated negations close both exchange and intimate alliance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a follower appeal, leaders' admitted inability, reciprocal failed rescue, and later unavailable exchange and intimacy; I infer one cascading failure of delegated support. The scenes may remain parallel rather than describe a literal chain of command, but the mechanism of non-transfer survives either way.

changed_reading.before: Satan alone abandons those who followed him.
changed_reading.after: Satan's abandonment is the terminal instance of a surah-wide support failure: neither leaders, bargains, intimate allies, nor the alleged partner can transfer guidance, sufficiency, or rescue at settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus tree comparison gives speech a durability test. The true promise can be reread as a word with stable root and continuing yield, while the broken promise resembles a bad word uprooted whole and lacking any settled base.

activation_trace.role: The repeated promise is the focus speech-object whose durability the later word imagery can test.
Nonperformance supplies the focus sign that Satan's word did not remain dependable.
An intelligible word or expression supplies the explicit object compared to a living structure.
Durability and fixity give the good word a persistence criterion.
Whole-root extraction supplies the failure mode of a word that cannot endure.
Stability and settlement are explicitly absent from the bad word's image.
Active strengthening joins the stable saying to people who remain steady across temporal settings.

structural_cues: 14:24-27 follows the focus with good and bad word structures, then repeats the stable-saying construction.
The focus already contrasts truth-aligned promise and admitted breach, allowing the later stability contrast to act as a performance image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two promises and then a good-word/bad-word tree contrast; I map promise reliability onto rootedness and uprooting. The live alternative is that the tree comparison classifies speech generally and is not a direct label for either promise in 14:22.

changed_reading.before: The broken promise is false because its content was deceptive.
changed_reading.after: The broken promise is also structurally rootless: unlike a stable word that persists and yields, it has no settled support once its hearers demand performance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence portrays error as substitution: blessing is exchanged away, rivals are installed, and those rivals route people off the path. Satan's disavowal therefore voids a user-made assignment of share and guidance, not an authority he ever possessed in himself.

activation_trace.role: Participation and assigned share anchor the focus in a constructed relation between more than one party.
Partnering with God supplies the theological limit that the constructed relation violates.
Satan's disavowal cancels the share attributed to him when that attribution is invoked.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the substitution step that creates the false arrangement.
Good condition and bestowed benefit identify what is displaced by that substitution.
A matching but opposed counterpart supplies the installed-rival function.
Deviation from guidance gives the installed rival its routing effect.

structural_cues: 14:28 links replacement of blessing with unbelief; 14:30 then links making rivals with leading away from the path.
In 14:22, denial of sultan precedes disavowal of the audience's association, separating attributed status from actual power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, installed rivals, misdirection, and Satan's repudiation of the audience's association; I infer that the followers manufactured a guidance-role for him and then treated it as authority. The association may denote cultic partnership, obedience, or causal attribution, and those scopes remain live.

changed_reading.before: Satan merely denies being worshiped as a partner.
changed_reading.after: Satan exposes partnership as a human-installed substitution: they assigned him a share and routing role, responded to it, and only at settlement discover that the assigned rival never owned the authority they projected onto him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later prayer and warning scenes turn response into both an allocation and a timed opportunity. Prayer is directed to one who hears, acceptance is sought, and wrongdoers offer to answer the divine call only after punishment arrives; the focus records that they had instead answered Satan before the matter was closed.

activation_trace.role: Completion and expiry close the focus response window before Satan's admission begins.
Satan's verbal solicitation is the call to which response was allocated during the open period.
The completed answer anchors the focus in an actual earlier uptake, not a merely heard sound.
Hearing sound gives prayer a contrasting direction toward a hearer rather than toward the deceptive caller.
Prayer as calling supplies the alternative orientation of the same call field.
Acceptance with willing reception supplies what the petitioner asks for his prayer.
The repeated prayer keeps directed calling active in the surah's later response field.
Warning that awakens caution defines the call's proper pre-event function.
Nearness in time and an approaching expiry frame the requested extra term as a reopening attempt.
The wrongdoers explicitly offer the answer they withheld until consequence is present.
The divine call becomes the newly claimed destination of a response offered too late.

structural_cues: 14:44 joins a request for postponement with 'we will answer Your call and follow the messengers.'
14:22 begins only once the matter has been completed, so its earlier 'you answered me' cannot be exchanged for a new answer at that point.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calls in opposite directions, hearing and requested acceptance of prayer, a late offer to answer, and final completion; I infer that response has both a chosen destination and a closing time. Prayer is not grammatically identical to answering a summons, so its contribution is contrastive orientation rather than equation.

changed_reading.before: The followers once made the wrong choice by answering Satan.
changed_reading.after: Their error is misallocated responsiveness within a finite window: they gave timely uptake to Satan's call, then attempt to redirect that same responsive capacity toward the divine call only after settlement has made redirection unavailable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late explicit denial that God breaks His promise to the messengers converts the focus contrast into a fulfillment guarantee. Divine promise is backed by execution after denial, whereas Satan's promise is admitted breach without capacity to deliver or rescue.

activation_trace.role: The focus sets the two promise-makers inside the same expectation-opening form.
Truth as stable correspondence marks the divine promise before later fulfillment language verifies it.
Satan names his own promise as the non-occurring commitment.
The same breach image is directly negated of God, creating an exact performance contrast.
The promise to the messengers supplies the later commitment whose non-breach is asserted.
Punishment following denial supplies the execution edge behind the promise's fulfillment.

structural_cues: 14:47 repeats both promise and breach language from 14:22 but negates breach of God.
The focus's no-rescue clauses show that Satan lacks any delivery capacity after admitting nonperformance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct lexical reversal and punishment after denial; I infer that enforceable performance, not merely reassuring wording, distinguishes the promises. The vengeance branch concerns consequence rather than contractual security as such, so the backing relation is reader-supplied.

changed_reading.before: God tells the truth, while Satan lies.
changed_reading.after: The contrast is operational: God's promise remains performable and is explicitly not breached, while Satan's promise was never backed by authority, delivery, or rescue and ends in confessed default.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late accounting frame turns 'blame yourselves' into an allocation rule. Each self remains the endpoint of what it acquired and receives a corresponding return; Satan's solicitation is causally relevant but does not transfer the respondents' entries onto his ledger.

activation_trace.role: Deserved blame is redirected toward the parties whose response made the solicitation effective.
The self as one's own identity anchors the focus allocation in each respondent.
Counting and account name the day on which responsibility is formally reckoned.
Corresponding return for an act supplies the ledger's settlement operation.
Every self remains an individually identified accounting endpoint.
Absence of delay marks the final account as execution rather than further deliberation.
The repeated accounting image closes the surah with individualized reckoning.

structural_cues: 14:51 coordinates every self with what it acquired; the acquisition root has no branch inventory and is retained here as a structural cue.
14:22 preserves both Satan's admitted breach and the followers' response, allowing differentiated rather than exclusive responsibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies redirected blame, every self, corresponding recompense, and acquired action; I infer a non-transferable ledger in which causal contributors can bear distinct entries. A live alternative is not that Satan is innocent, but that his deceptive call and each follower's uptake are separately chargeable.

changed_reading.before: Satan shifts blame away from himself onto his victims.
changed_reading.after: The blame redirection identifies the respondents' non-transferable share without clearing Satan's own breach: caller and answerer occupy different causal entries, and each self is settled for what became its own act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's closing declaration identifies the message's endpoint as recognition of one deity without partner. Satan's earlier disavowal functions as a negative disclosure within that endpoint: the alleged partner himself publicly voids the share assigned to him.

activation_trace.role: The focus names the forbidden divine partnership whose collapse is being displayed.
The alleged partner's disavowal performs the public severance of that attribution.
Delivery of a message supplies the communicative endpoint into which the focus disclosure feeds.
Warning intended to awaken caution identifies why the collapse is disclosed before settlement.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the final state against which Satan's assigned share is void.

structural_cues: 14:52 closes the surah by coordinating proclamation, warning, knowledge of one deity, and recollection.
14:22 makes the false partner state both his lack of sultan and his repudiation of the partnership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a final monotheistic purpose and an earlier partner's self-disavowal; I infer that the speech dramatizes departnering as part of the warning. Satan's self-exculpating motive remains live and need not be replaced by this broader function.

changed_reading.before: Satan's disavowal is only a defensive statement inside the judgment scene.
changed_reading.after: His disavowal also stages the terminal collapse of partnership: the figure granted a false share denies owning it, leaving the surah's one-without-partner claim exposed by the failed partner's own testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the same root moves from human covering or denial of blessing to Satan's disavowal of their association; it remains valid because each occurrence and branch is packet-supplied and the focus explicitly uses the disavowal branch. Downstream prose should describe a patterned reversal, not pretend that all occurrences carry one identical lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِنِّي كَفَرْتُ بِمَا أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ makes Satan perform كفر toward the relation formed by people repeatedly characterized through كفر.

activation_trace.role: Disavowal supplies Satan's final repudiating act toward the attributed partnership.
Covering blessing supplies the followers' earlier denial side of the reversal.
Substitution shows their kufr installed in the place of received benefit.
Intensified covering of blessing makes human repudiation a repeated surah-level pattern.

changed_reading.before: Satan says that he rejects the partnership attributed to him.
changed_reading.after: The followers' long practice of covering received benefit returns as a counter-repudiation: the false partner answers their kufr with his own differently scoped kufr, so a relation founded on denial ends in reciprocal denial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from و ع د to ع د د and must not be offered as the lexical translation of وَعَدَ. It remains worth carrying because the mapped target is explicitly packet-provided, the focus repeats the root three times, and 14:34 activates counting and failed enumeration. Downstream prose should qualify it as a provisioning wordplay: a promise can be tested for the reserve or readiness behind it.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated وَعَدَ/وَعْدَ/وَعَدتُّكُمْ is packet-mapped not only to promise branches but also to ع د د, including preparation of an عُدَّة.

activation_trace.role: Prepared reserve and readiness turn the repeated promises into exploratory claims about what stands behind future delivery.
Counting the supplied benefits activates the shared mapped target in an explicit enumeration setting.
Exhaustive enumeration fails because the divine provision exceeds the counters' capacity.
Actual benefit supplies the delivered reserve against which an empty promise can be compared.

changed_reading.before: The two promises differ only in truth value.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they differ in provisioning: the true promise is surrounded by delivered benefit beyond counting, while Satan's promise has no prepared reserve, authority, or rescue capacity behind its future-facing words.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the cut-and-opening branch of ج و ب into a form whose direct sense is answering. It remains anchored because both the literal response branch and the spatial branch belong to the packet's focus inventory, and the same root recurs in the late-response scene. Downstream prose should say that response acts as if it opens ingress for a call, never translate استجبتم as physical perforation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَاسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِي places the respondents' ج و ب act immediately after Satan reduces his mechanism to a call.

activation_trace.role: Reply to speech keeps the model tied to the direct answering construction.
A penetrating cut supplies the exploratory spatial image of uptake creating an entry.
Opening what was closed and widening an entrance activates an ingress mechanism elsewhere in the surah.
The offered late answer reactivates the opening image only after the effective response period has closed.
Near expiry contains the opening image temporally and prevents it from becoming a claim of unlimited revisability.

changed_reading.before: Satan's call itself entered and controlled the hearers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the call remained outside until their answer cut an opening for it; causal ingress belongs to responsive uptake, which is why a merely verbal call can matter without possessing coercive sultan.

strongest_changes: The call-response clause became a model of mediated agency: speech initiates, but audience uptake supplies causal traction without converting the call into coercive sultan.
The immediate follower-leader dialogue and the later absence of sale and intimate alliance expanded reciprocal no-rescue into the collapse of a whole substitute support network.
The good-word and bad-word trees recast promise quality as durability: fulfilled truth is rooted, while admitted breach is structurally without settlement.
The late offer to answer the divine call and the exact non-breach echo in 14:47 made timing and performable backing central to the contrast.
The closing self-accounting frame preserved differentiated responsibility: Satan's deceptive breach and each respondent's uptake remain separate, non-transferable entries.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence connected call, answer, sultan, promise, breach, partnership, rescue, and self-accounting across messenger disputes, the immediate follower scene, the post-focus word imagery, and the final warning. This made 14:22 read less as a single blame-shifting speech and more as an audit of how false authority is communicated, installed, answered, tested, and finally dissolved.
remaining_uncertainties: The rooted and uprooted word images strongly revise the promise reading, but the packet does not explicitly identify either tree with a specific promise in 14:22.
The scope of أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ may emphasize cultic partnership, obedience, or projected causal authority; the activated models preserve all three possibilities.
The ع د د provisioning and ج و ب opening readings depend on explicit but form-distant packet branches and should remain qualified exploratory activations.
Satan's denial of coercive authority does not by itself measure his culpability for deception; the self-ledger model assigns distinct responsibility without quantifying either share.
